displayContract.byline: Assessments made by 5.6 Sol. — Rubric: Slugfester Reassessment Rubric v2.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that idealism merits consideration as a comparative metaphysical model only if phenomenal realization can reproduce physical causal structure and generate consequences that distinguish it from nonconscious quantum interpretations.

novelty.explanation: This narrows the live conclusion and repairs the missing requirements of causal realization, comparative testing, and interpretive discrimination.

premises.text: Immediate experience supplies direct epistemic access to phenomenal states, whereas any account of a material substrate is reached through theoretical inference from structured experience.

novelty.explanation: This develops the experiential parsimony argument without claiming that epistemic immediacy alone establishes ontological priority.

premises.text: An idealist model may preserve every counterfactual causal relation described by physics by treating phenomenal or experiential structure as the realizer rather than deleting that structure.

novelty.explanation: This answers the physical-interaction objection by preserving causal organization instead of treating experienced qualities as explanatorily complete.

premises.text: Preconscious development can be represented as law-governed evolution of relational states whose durable records become definite relative to later interactions, without requiring continuous attention by a local mind.

novelty.explanation: This strengthens the development account by emphasizing relational evolution and durable records rather than mere later visual appearance.

premises.text: Quantum contextuality does not itself establish consciousness dependence, but it can motivate testing models in which experiential context has a specified and independently measurable physical role.

novelty.explanation: This corrects the conflation between contextuality and consciousness while retaining contextuality as motivation for a narrower research proposal.

premises.text: The cumulative case gains force only when each contributing result is independently supported and the idealist model outperforms materialist and nonconscious alternatives under shared predictive criteria.

novelty.explanation: This imports the strongest evidential objection as a constraint on any responsible cumulative idealist inference.

conclusion.text: Accordingly, idealism may remain a serious comparative hypothesis, but treating consciousness as fundamental is justified only to the extent that a precise model matches physical causation and survives discriminating public tests.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion proportionately limits support for idealism to demonstrated causal adequacy and comparative empirical performance.

newArguments.title: Structural Realization Test
newArguments.text: Instead of arguing that experienced qualities replace physical properties, the idealist can define a realization map between phenomenal relations and the counterfactual organization measured by physics. The model must recover friction, chemical bonding, field interactions, conservation behavior, and stable records without changing successful quantitative predictions. This reframes the dispute: matter is not discarded as useless description, but interpreted as the public structural profile of an experiential substrate. Failure to construct such a map would count against the proposal, while success would answer the claim that idealism necessarily removes causal capacities.

novelty.explanation: This is a new formal adequacy test requiring an explicit mapping between phenomenal realization and physical counterfactual structure.

newArguments.title: Comparative Observer Protocol
newArguments.text: A defensible consciousness-linked quantum model should preregister operational distinctions among conscious observation, unconscious biological detection, automated measurement, environmental decoherence, and later human inspection. It should then identify an outcome distribution that differs from leading nonconscious interpretations while holding apparatus and information transfer constant. Replication by independent laboratories would satisfy the public standard even if consciousness itself remained theoretically described rather than directly inspected. This proposal repairs the hidden-variable response by making the target comparative: evidence must select a consciousness-sensitive model over contextual rivals, not merely confirm contextuality or reject one family of hidden variables.

novelty.explanation: This converts the proposed defeater into a discriminating, independently repeatable experimental protocol responsive to the negative's strongest testability objection.

thesis.text: The AI steelman is that fundamental-consciousness claims should remain epistemically unpreferred unless they specify causal realization and produce independently reproducible consequences that outperform materially or structurally neutral explanations.

novelty.explanation: This integrates the negative's public-evidence, causal-adequacy, and testability routes into one proportionate comparative thesis.

premises.text: Publicly warranted ontological claims require consequences that multiple observers can examine independently, whether those consequences arise through direct observation or reliable indirect measurement.

novelty.explanation: This preserves the shared-evidence standard while explicitly allowing indirect confirmation of theoretical entities.

premises.text: A cumulative inference is strengthened by independently supported components only when their conjunction favors the proposed ontology over relevant competitors rather than merely exposing explanatory gaps.

novelty.explanation: This develops the component-evidence comparison into an explicit likelihood requirement among competing explanations.

premises.text: Any acceptable ontology must recover the counterfactual causal capacities represented by physical properties, including forces, chemical organization, stable records, and interactions occurring without human experience.

novelty.explanation: This unifies the interaction and preconscious-history objections around preservation of experimentally supported causal structure.

premises.text: Quantum contextuality constrains assignments of values but does not by itself identify conscious observation as the relevant context or establish a fundamentally mental substrate.

novelty.explanation: This supplies the missing technical distinction underlying the negative's challenge to the proposed falsification condition.

premises.text: When two ontologies reproduce the same observations and causal structure, adding a fundamental experiential or divine element earns preference only through further explanatory compression or novel predictive success.

novelty.explanation: This states a symmetrical parsimony rule based on comparative explanatory work rather than familiarity with material ontology.

conclusion.text: Therefore, withholding preference from the idealist ontology is warranted until it identifies a consciousness-specific mechanism, preserves preconscious causal development, and passes comparative tests unavailable to empirically equivalent alternatives.

novelty.explanation: The conclusion requires further evidence without claiming that idealism is false or incapable of future empirical development.

newArguments.title: Equivalence-Class Challenge
newArguments.text: The negative can classify interpretations by their observable predictions rather than treating every metaphysical difference as immediately testable. If idealist collapse, nonconscious contextualism, and decoherence-based accounts occupy the same empirical equivalence class, existing quantum results cannot select among them. The burden then shifts to a consciousness-specific mechanism that changes some measurable conditional probability or compresses the total explanation without auxiliary assumptions. This framework avoids declaring the proposal absolutely unfalsifiable: it says instead that the evidence presently cited underdetermines the ontology, while leaving open the possibility that a future model could exit the equivalence class.

novelty.explanation: This introduces empirical equivalence classes as a more precise alternative to a categorical unfalsifiability diagnosis.

newArguments.title: Historical Record Constraint
newArguments.text: Pre-observer history is supported not merely by a reconstructed story but by mutually constraining records across cosmology, geology, chemistry, and evolutionary biology. An observer-dependent account must explain why these records display stable cross-domain agreement, how their causal dependencies formed before local consciousness, and what would differ if only later definite appearance were involved. Calling the underlying evolution informational does not discharge that requirement unless the information has dynamics capable of producing the same counterfactual dependencies. This strengthens the original development objection while avoiding the overstatement that no evolution whatsoever can occur in an uncollapsed description.

novelty.explanation: This repairs the categorical stoppage claim by grounding the objection in convergent historical records and their causal dependencies.
